mapper.sql: left join SYS_ROLE RO on B.BIZ_POWER = RO.ROLE_ID left join SYS_POSITION POS on POS.POSITION_ID = B.EXT_INFO2 left join AREA_XZQH_SUBDISTRICT AXS on AXS.SUBDISTRICT_ID = B.BIZ_AREA_ID LEFT JOIN AREA_XZQH_COMMUNITY CM ON CM.COMMUNITY_ID=B.BIZ_AREA_ID
